basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and truck enthusiast from Florida, USA. I recently got into MapleStory and love exploring different MMOs. My interests include playing Sea of Thieves with friends and keeping up with the latest updates on classic cars like the 280ZX. I work as a delivery driver for a local company, which gives me plenty of time to think about game strategies during long drives. Usually online in the evenings after work. Single and enjoying the freedom of exploring new hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a casual understanding of online gaming communities, primarily gained through self-teaching and exploring different subreddits. My knowledge in MapleStory is still growing as I spend more time in the game and engage with other players.
